SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

Lakeside Ambulatory Surgery Center (fictional)
EGD procedure report

Patient: Riley Brennan (fictional)
Synthetic record: SYN-GI-2003
Date of procedure: 2026-10-20
Location: Lakeside Ambulatory Surgery Center, endoscopy room 2
Endoscopist: Dr. Mei Tanaka, MD (fictional)

Procedure performed
Esophagogastroduodenoscopy with cold forceps biopsy.

Indications
Epigastric pain and dyspepsia not responding to a proton pump inhibitor; evaluate for Helicobacter pylori gastritis.

Sedation
Monitored anesthesia care provided by the anesthesia team.

Technique
After informed consent, the gastroscope was introduced through the mouth and advanced under direct vision to the second part of the duodenum. The examination was completed without difficulty and the patient tolerated the procedure well.

Findings
The esophagus was normal; the Z-line was regular at 39 cm.
Patchy erythema was seen in the gastric antrum. Cold forceps biopsies were obtained from the gastric antrum and gastric body for Helicobacter pylori.
The duodenal bulb and second part of the duodenum were normal.

Impression
Antral erythema, biopsied. Normal esophagus and duodenum.

Recommendations
Await pathology. Continue the proton pump inhibitor. Follow-up office visit in 4 weeks.
